problem:
Which of the following elementary row operations transforms the matrix $X$ into the matrix $W$, where

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 5 \\ 5 & 6 & 10 \\ 1 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}],\,W=[\begin{aligned}5 & -5 & -10 \\ 5 & 6 & 10 \\ 1 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}]?
$$

feedback.problem:
Which of the following elementary row operations transforms the matrix $A$ into the matrix $B$, where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & -3 \\ -8 & 0 & 2 \\ 10 & 5 & -5\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & -3 \\ -8 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}]?
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, notice that the $1$st and the $2$nd rows are the same in both matrices. The only row that has changed is the $3$rd row. 

By considering the given row operations that modify the $3$rd row, we notice that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & -3 \\ -8 & 0 & 2 \\ 10 & 5 & -5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3}:=\frac{1}{5}\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & -3 \\ -8 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =B.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{3}:=\frac{1}{5}\cdot {R}_{3}.
$$
